title: Intel Neuromorphic Computing Hardware & Research Ecosystem
summary: Intel Labs develops neuromorphic hardware including Loihi 2 processors and the Hala Point system (1.15 billion neurons), aiming for sustainable AI via sparse event-driven computation. Tools like Lava support neuro-inspired application development across sensing, robotics, healthcare, and telecoms. The Intel Neuromorphic Research Community fosters global collaboration to transition technology from prototypes to products.
tldr: Intel offers Loihi 2 processors and the Hala Point system for energy-efficient neuromorphic AI applications in sectors like robotics and telecommunications through a collaborative research community.
evidence: Intel Labs provides tools for developers to advance the development process of neuromorphic computing.
Hala Point, the industry's first 1.15 billion neuron neuromorphic system, builds a path toward more sustainable AI.
Loihi 2 outperforms its predecessor with up to 10x faster processing capability and comes with Lava software framework.
Research using Loihi 2 processors has demonstrated orders of magnitude gains in the efficiency, speed, and adaptability of small-scale edge workloads.
location: Global (with specific mentions of Israel, Singapore)
